summary_text: In February 2026, the user placed orders on 8 independent dates, primarily on weekdays (4) and weekends (4). Activity spanned morning, afternoon, evening, and night dayparts. The basket composition was diverse, covering cooking essentials (Besan, Cooking Oil, Ghee, Sugar, Jaggery, Salt, Pulses), laundry care (Washing Bar, Washing Powder), personal care (Shampoo, Facewash), electronics (Bluetooth Headset), and specific meal ingredients (Poha, Curd Yogurt, Rava Sooji, Vegetables). No single product category or brand was purchased on more than one independent date, preventing the establishment of durable preferences or stable routines. All observed behaviors are isolated to single dates.
shopping_need_text: The user demonstrates needs for basic home cooking ingredients, laundry supplies, personal hygiene products, and occasional electronics. Specific meal preparation needs are inferred from ingredient combinations like oil/vegetables or poha/curd/sooji.
uncertainty_text: All inferences are based on single-date observations. No repeated behavior across independent dates was observed for any product, brand, or category combination. Therefore, no durable preferences, routines, or stable patterns can be established. Confidence in all inferred behaviors is low.
